title: Separate paper valuation time from admitted market quote time

root_cause_analysis.predate_rejection: Taiwan MARKET orders intentionally fill from the admitted daily close at wall-clock commit time. Previously, value_portfolio rejected still-age-eligible quotes whenever their event_time predated the fill with 'market_marks_predate_ledger', preventing a fresh daily snapshot from valuing same-day filled books.
root_cause_analysis.sample_backdating: Previously, value_portfolio calculated sample as_of as min() across used marks, omitting the ledger fill timestamp and backdating the portfolio sample to the earliest quote rather than the latest intrinsic boundary across fills and marks.

remediation.performance_telemetry: Removed predating_ledger rejection in value_portfolio. Sample as_of is now the latest intrinsic timestamp (max) across the last committed fill (ledger_as_of) and all used marks. Each MarketMark.as_of and source_ref remains unchanged as admitted. No wall-clock now, receipt time, or rewritten event_time is substituted for quotes or ledger timestamps.
remediation.contract_preservation: Retains original max_mark_age_seconds (172800s) and future_tolerance_seconds (300s) fail-closed behavior, invalid ledger fail-closed, missing/invalid mark fail-closed, and currency/alias isolation.

synthetic_source_only_controls.diagnosis: Proves that a fresh daily date bucket predating wall-clock paper fill was rejected by the old guard while after-fill marks valued. Contract repair resolves this mismatch by accepting age-eligible admitted daily closes.

hosted_delivery_distinction.notes: Explicitly distinguishes source delivery from hosted fresh-mark finance. Real fresh 10/12 Taiwan market marks, provider reset / FULL qualification (12:00 UTC), and coordinator same-final hosted acceptance remain outstanding. No actual provider calls, VM mutations, human votes, or task-state direct writes occurred.

test_results.services/execution/lean_runtime/test_per: 28 passed in 4.41s (e2e PaperExecutionAlgorithm ledger/provider/valuator counter, updated timing contract with before/after rationale, stale/future/missing-fill fail-closed, wall-clock now fingerprint invariance preventing drawdown duplication)
test_results.services/execution/lean_runtime/test_pap: 8 failed, 8 passed in 3.03s (pre-existing failures preserved: 8 tests fail due to worker environment read-only /data filesystem [Errno 30], not from code regression)
